note: Mostly seasonal campground a few miles from Wisconsin Dells with a swimming pond and beach, heated pool, bar and grill, and cabins and cottages along the pond. Nightly RV sites (pull-through, ridge and deluxe loops) sit south of the pond near the office. --Claude
summary: Operator site (campsites, 2026 map, seasonal, amenities, rules) and Google read. About 60 of 196 sites are nightly (31%), the rest seasonal: keep with the mostly-seasonal caveat. Price gate passes cleanly (cheapest RV night $43.50 spring/fall W/E; summer W/E 30 amp $46.50; summer peak $63 deluxe, holiday $77). Google 4.6/172. Staylist booking. Not waterfront kept.
flags: PRICE GATE (private): passes. The cheapest RV night is $43.50 (W/E 30 or 50 amp, spring and fall), and summer W/E 30 amp is $46.50. Summer peak: $63.00 (deluxe), VIP $61.99, P1-P7 and W/E/S $55.50; holiday tops out at $77.00 (deluxe). Stored nightly_high 69 omitted the VIP and deluxe rows; 69 -> 77. Good Sam false (derived) not re-checked; no discount is needed.

LONG-STAY: by the 2026 map's legend colours, 60 of 196 sites are nightly (58 RV + 2 tent) and about 136 are seasonal, so the nightly share is about 31%. That is 10-50%: keep with the caveat, which the note and sites.note now state. There is a posted nightly rate table and a Staylist booking site, and the holiday 3-night minimum applies to holiday dates only. Nothing on the site discourages nightly guests.

TEST 5 (flag for the reviewer): the seasonal page says 'stay up to date on the seasonal sites available for sale at the park', under a 'Seasonal Sites For Sale' heading whose listing is empty. That reads like campers' units on seasonal sites changing hands, but it could be read as selling sites. I found no lot sale or lease terms.
GOOGLE: 4.6 stars over 172 reviews (the place at 1130 Freedom Ct).

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. The swimming/fishing ponds (the larger about 230 x 60 m, about 1.2 ha, so 'pond' vocabulary) are lined on the north by seasonal sites 24 and 44-48 and on the south by rental cabins A-D and BC1-BC3. The nightly W/E 50 sites 6-11 sit behind that cabin row, and tent sites T1-T2 are tent-only. No nightly RV site is on the water.

PIN: 43.7566,-89.8045 is the entrance and office on Freedom Court (Google's point). The nightly loops (D, P, R) centre on about 43.7585,-89.8039, about 210 m north, so a re-pin is optional and under 250 m.
SEASON: not published. The specials run 04/09-10/18 in 2026 and events run April/May to October; left unset.
PHONE: 608-305-8404 confirmed (site, map and Google). WEBSITE: https://campthedells.com/ works (200).
Rule: 'You must be 21 years old to make a reservation' is not an age-restricted (55+) park.
